meta.name: Dogtanian and the Three Muskehounds (DArtacan y los tres Mosqueperros)
meta.description: France, 17th century, under the reign of Louis XIII. Dogtanian is an impetuous and innocent peasant from Gascony, as well as a skilled swordsman, who travels to Paris with the purpose of making his dream come true: to join the Corps of Muskehounds of the Royal Guard.
